title: Worklist keeps filters, shows cards on tablet, drops deleted assets
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Filters/chip/search/sort you can set; a browser you can narrow below tablet width; a disposable test asset you can delete or make inactive (or whose customer can be deleted).
custom_steps:
1. Set tiles, the chip, a location filter, a search and a sort, leave the tab and come back; check what is kept and what the address bar carries.
  2. Narrow the browser below tablet width and read the layout, the tiles and the row menu.
  3. Delete or deactivate a test asset (or its customer) and check the worklist and that its history is kept.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Leaving and returning keeps the tiles, chip, location filter, search and sort (filters saved to the user and carried in the address, sort personal, search kept for the browser Back).
  • Below tablet width the worklist shows one card per row; the tiles scroll sideways and the row menu opens as an action sheet.
  • An asset deleted or made inactive, or whose customer is deleted, leaves the worklist; its history is kept.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R42: “Leaving the list and coming back keeps its tiles, chip, location filter, search and sort, following the Work Orders list: filters are saved to the user and carried in the address, sort is personal, and search is kept for the browser's Back”
  • S13-R39: “Below tablet width the worklist shows one card per row, as the Customers list does; the tiles scroll sideways and the row menu opens as an action sheet”
  • S13-E5: “An asset that is deleted or made inactive, or whose customer is deleted, leaves the worklist. Its history is kept per S21-R6”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
